disclosure_rule: v6, F13 (Paul approved 2026-09-26): a memo whose normalised receipt/memo text matches disclosure_pattern states a re-disclosure. It is counted once, via the counted parent it restates (same company, committee, contributor, nonzero amount, parent dated on or before the memo, parent not a memo): schema.R mentat_memo_redisclosure_parents and tools/pac_evidence.py memo_redisclosure_parents. With no such parent, or when the text calls the gift unitemized, it stays counted and flagged disclosure_memo_unmatched. Phrases are the ones filers use in the saved Crypto, Banking, Telecom, Credit Arms and Community Banks receipts; bare PREVIOUSLY REPORTED is left out because JFC allocation memos use it for partial allocations.
